snippet.title: Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion | Demo Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
From Marvelous First Studio comes an action-packed new entry in the Daemon X Machina series releasing September 5, 2025. 

Created and produced by Kenichiro Tsukuda and featuring stunning mechanical designs from Shoji Kawamori, Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion takes the franchise in a dramatic new direction. 

Humanity’s fight for liberation begins now!

Find out more on: 
Web: https://eu.daemonxmachina.com/titanicscion/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/DXM_game
